one_line: Teaches an agent reusable procedures from a shared human-agent trace.
what_it_does: Records semantic human and WebMCP actions, compiles a vendor-evaluation routine, and replays it with fresh inputs and human approval.
leverage_rationale: Shared semantic state and deterministic routine compilation are substantially more reliable than UI-driving automation.
leverage_evidence: One command bus records UI and WebMCP actions.
Compiler separates variables, policy, procedures, and examples.
Replay pauses at learned approval boundary.
execution_rationale: Coherent, intentionally scoped MVP, but no video limits verification.
execution_evidence: Explicitly scoped to deterministic vendor evaluation.
impact_rationale: Addresses repeated workflow teaching and safe human judgment for agent users.
impact_evidence: Fresh evidence and uncertainty are used on replay.
creativity_rationale: Separating durable policy from one-off corrections is an original teaching interaction.
usability_note: Model appears understandable; end-to-end usability is not observed.
advance_reason: High originality and strong WebMCP collaboration model.

one_line: Human approval dynamically exposes and revokes consequential WebMCP capabilities.
what_it_does: Defines a mission envelope, stages a synthetic supplier release, exposes commit only after approval, and verifies a cryptographic receipt.
leverage_rationale: The commit tool is absent before approval and unregisters after use, making authority lifecycle a structured agent surface.
leverage_evidence: Seven tools become eight only after approval.
Commit unregisters after action.
Receipt verification is independently recomputable.
execution_rationale: Tightly scoped proof-carrying delegation flow with policy, approval, commit, receipt, and audit.
impact_rationale: Directly addresses authority, evidence, and auditability for consequential agent workflows.
impact_evidence: Mission includes spending ceiling and approval threshold.
creativity_rationale: Dynamic capability exposure tied to approval is memorable and technically specific.
usability_note: Visible approval and audit concepts suggest strong operator clarity.
standouts: Capability exposure is the approval mechanism.
advance_reason: Exceptional leverage and distinctive safety workflow.

one_line: A browser photo editor whose agent edits controls while explaining them to beginners.
what_it_does: Applies requested adjustments, records values and explanations, supports per-step undo, highlights controls, and audits histogram detail.
leverage_rationale: Structured control access enables exact values, shared history, highlighting, and histogram inspection with less friction than UI driving.
leverage_evidence: 56 WebMCP tools claimed.
Shared undoable human-agent history.
Live histogram audit.
execution_rationale: Detailed video transcript demonstrates editing, explanation, undo, navigation help, audit, and comparison.
execution_evidence: Alive demo, gallery, and public repo.
impact_rationale: Directly serves beginners blocked by opaque photo terminology.
impact_evidence: Every edit names control, value, and meaning.
Users retain manual control and targeted undo.
creativity_rationale: Agent editing plus contextual vocabulary teaching is a fresh angle on an editor.
advance_reason: Strong execution and impact with compelling educational interaction.

one_line: Turns long-running agent work into a shared mountain expedition with verified blockers and approvals.
what_it_does: Maps mission state to camps, routes, weather, blockers, and evidence; agents propose actions while humans authorize consequential repairs.
leverage_rationale: Structured mission semantics make blockers, approvals, evidence, and completion shared live state.
leverage_evidence: 18 closed-schema tools manipulate mission semantics.
Blockers change route and weather.
Human authorizes repair; Summit requires verification.
execution_rationale: Coherent state machine with visible mountain interaction, though no video proves the full workflow.
execution_evidence: Frame sheet shows mountain, markers, and contextual card.
impact_rationale: Developers and technical leads need understandable blockers, approvals, and proof beyond chat.
creativity_rationale: Mountain metaphor is coupled deeply to mission semantics, not merely decorative.
creativity_evidence: Camps, fog, crevasses, forks, and Summit map to state.
usability_note: Memorable visual metaphor; onboarding may be needed.

one_line: Preserves checkpoints and recovers failed AI workflows under human approval.
what_it_does: Diagnoses provider failures, preserves work, compares recovery options, requires approval to switch provider, resumes, and verifies completion.
leverage_rationale: Structured failure, checkpoint, approval, and verification are more reliable than dashboard inference.
leverage_evidence: Seven WebMCP tools claimed.
HTTP 429 at 73% resumes from preserved checkpoint.
Provider switch requires approval.
execution_rationale: Specific coherent workflow, but no frame sheets or video cap execution confidence.
execution_evidence: Alive demo and seven gallery images.
impact_rationale: Checkpoint preservation addresses costly AI workflow failure and recovery uncertainty.
creativity_rationale: Solid synthesis of checkpointing, provider recovery, approval, and WebMCP verification.
creativity_evidence: Recovery rather than only monitoring or retrying.
usability_note: Focused control-room workflow, but no visual evidence.
advance_reason: Strong practical impact despite missing execution evidence.

one_line: Lets an agent fill a tax form with highlighted, reviewable, reversible changes.
what_it_does: Records AI field changes and rationales, supports undo or acceptance, previews submission, and requires confirmation.
leverage_rationale: Structured field changes and review state improve precision and auditability over generic UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Modified fields show status and rationales.
Per-field undo or accept.
Preview and final confirmation.
execution_rationale: Coherent eight-step flow, but no video limits end-to-end evidence.
execution_evidence: Alive demo, public repo, eight gallery images.
ABOUT enumerates fill, review, preview, confirmation.
impact_rationale: Reviewable assistance is valuable for consequential tax forms.
impact_evidence: Manual override and explicit final confirmation.
creativity_rationale: Familiar human-reviewable form filling with useful field-level rationale and reversibility.
standouts: Good safety posture for form filling.

one_line: Audits, red-teams, hardens, and human-gates WebMCP tools.
what_it_does: Imports tools, checks schemas and injection indicators, runs attack samples, generates hardened code, and queues sensitive calls for approval.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP-specific findings and approval gates are difficult to reproduce reliably through generic UI automation.
leverage_evidence: Checks risk, schema, injection, sensitive data, and outputs.
Red-team cases include poisoned descriptions and exfiltration.
Sensitive calls wait for human decision.
execution_rationale: Coherent workbench visible in the frame sheet, though complete attack-to-hardening flow is not shown.
execution_evidence: Frame sheet shows structured dark Guard Studio workspace.
Import, analysis, red-team, hardening, approval described.
impact_rationale: Directly addresses prompt injection and unsafe WebMCP tool outputs.
impact_evidence: Generates stricter schemas, limits, audit events, and approval checks.
creativity_rationale: Dedicated WebMCP security workbench with red-team and generated hardening is differentiated.
creativity_evidence: Static analysis plus adversarial testing and runtime gate.
usability_note: Structured workbench appears appropriate but may be complex.
standouts: Strong domain specificity and threat model.
advance_reason: High relevance and differentiated security workflow.

one_line: A browser 3D studio where agents and humans build models through many tools.
what_it_does: Combines a 3D workspace, physics, roughly 40 agent tools, and an Observe-Plan-Propose-Approve-Act-Verify workflow.
leverage_rationale: Structured geometry operations may outperform pixel automation, but unique reliability is not demonstrated.
leverage_evidence: edit_geometry and roughly 40 tools claimed.
Approval and verification are in the workflow.
execution_rationale: Understandable concept but sparse packet, no frames, no repo, and broad unverified claims.
execution_evidence: Alive demo and four gallery images.
impact_rationale: Could help creators without conventional desktop access, but audience and outcome are weakly evidenced.
creativity_rationale: Physics-enabled agent-assisted 3D editing is ambitious, though depth is unsubstantiated.
creativity_evidence: Large tool surface and explicit human-agent workflow.
usability_note: Broad 3D surface may be complex; cannot assess from packet.
advance_reason: Insufficient evidence for strong execution, leverage, or eligibility confidence.

one_line: Uses an agent to investigate contractor cost growth while procurement remains human-gated.
what_it_does: Joins public award and authorized-cost data with board-resolution explanations and keeps recommendation, award, and publication human-controlled.
leverage_rationale: Structured investigation and permanent decision boundaries are more precise and auditable than browsing public pages.
leverage_evidence: Joins award, authorized amount, and resolution reasons.
Agent investigates but cannot award or publish.
execution_rationale: Thoughtful domain model but no video and one gallery image limit verification.
impact_rationale: Agencies and taxpayers have a real transparency and cost-growth problem addressed by explanatory procurement analysis.
impact_evidence: Specific Illinois Tollway context and public sources.
creativity_rationale: Treating change-order growth as hidden procurement cost is a distinctive social application.
creativity_evidence: Links cost data to plain-language resolution explanations.
Uses WebMCP to define forbidden actions.
usability_note: Clear concept but data-heavy investigation may be demanding.
red_flags: No video and limited gallery evidence.
standouts: Excellent problem framing and intrinsic safety boundary.
advance_reason: High potential impact and original domain insight.

one_line: An infrastructure dashboard where agents inspect live services but humans approve risky operations.
what_it_does: Exposes live health, alerts, notes, restart, and scaling; risky actions require human confirmation and a single-use bound token before real Render API execution.
leverage_rationale: Structured live observability plus cryptographically bound approval is a meaningful reliability delta over UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Seven tools expose health and operations.
Risky actions require explicit approval and single-use token.
Real service and audit log claimed.
execution_rationale: Concrete architecture and live-service scenario, but no video proves an end-to-end action.
execution_evidence: Go backend, React frontend, real observability endpoints, Render calls described.
impact_rationale: Directly addresses safe remediation of production infrastructure.
impact_evidence: Uses real uptime, DB/Redis, metrics, and errors.
creativity_rationale: Known copilot pattern, strengthened by live integration and exact action binding.
creativity_evidence: Risk-based separation of immediate and gated tools.
